sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Basic Materials / Specialty Chemicals · Indonesia. PT Avia Avian Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes paints and building materials in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Architectural Solutions and Trading Goods. The company offers wall paint, special effects and texture paint, waterproofing paint, wood and iron paint, wood preservative, primer, putty, and roof and zinc paint products; and instant cement, including skim coat, lightweight brick adhesive, tile adhesive, instant putty, and plaster adhesive.
